```{r, setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(magrittr)
library(driveanalytics)
library(DT)

knitr::opts_knit$set(echo = FALSE)

# Get the render format
render_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get('rmarkdown.pandoc.to')
if (render_format == "") render_format <- "html"
```

## Overview
This analytics module simply formats and prints the basic demographic information for each patient in each cohort.

## Considerations and Limitations
* This should be used cautiously as it will expose patient identifiable information

## Example

```{r, example, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

# NOTE - this does not work without also attaching the DT javascript to the html page

# Create a random sample of patients in two cohorts and assign random events
set.seed(123)
n <- 10
df_pde <- tibble::tibble(
  project_id = 1:n,
  cohort_id = project_id,
  cohort = sample(c("A","B"), n, replace = TRUE),
  # Random names that are obviously not real people
  forename = paste0(sample(LETTERS, n, replace = TRUE), sample(letters, n, replace = TRUE)),
  surname = paste0(sample(LETTERS, n, replace = TRUE), sample(letters, n, replace = TRUE), sample(letters, n, replace = TRUE)),
  cohort_entry_date = lubridate::as_date(sample(as.Date("2000-1-1"):as.Date("2001-1-1"), n, replace = TRUE)),
  cohort_exit_date = lubridate::as_date(sample(as.Date("2002-1-1"):as.Date("2003-1-1"), n, replace = TRUE)),
)

# Perform frequency analysis and get results
driveanalytics::pde_cohort_list(df_pde)
```
